snippet.title: Bowling Crew: Get hooked!
snippet.description:
Meet free online 3D bowling game! Challenge bowlers from all over the world!

Join us on the Official Facebook page. Here you can read all latest news about our project: https://web.facebook.com/bowlingcrewgame/

Find friends in Facebook Bowling Crew ADD ME Group. Meet players and exchange Chips with them. Bowlers also share great advice and video guides there: https://web.facebook.com/groups/462731567714963/

Read news, guides, tips and tricks on our website: https://bowlingcrew.com/

Have a great time!

#bowlingcrew Contact us via the game app by going to Menu - Support. 
Terms of Use: https://kitomy.net/terms_of_service
Privacy Policy: https://kitomy.net/privacy_policy
